llm.summary: The skill is documentation-only and generally matches its stated purpose, but its SKILL.md references runtime requirements (npx/git and a ZHIPU_API_KEY) that are not declared in the skill metadata, which is an inconsistency you should be aware of.

dimensions.detail: The name/description (documentation-only GLM master guide) align with the SKILL.md content: it lists GLM skills and provides installation guidance. Nothing in the content appears intended to perform actions beyond guiding users to install other skills.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: The SKILL.md instructs agents/users to run commands (npx clawhub@latest, git clone) and to set an API key environment variable (ZHIPU_API_KEY). Those instructions are within the guide's purpose, but they reference runtime artifacts and credentials that the skill metadata does not declare — the instructions therefore access environment or runtime capabilities outside the declared scope.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: There is no install spec and no code shipped (instruction-only), which matches the claim 'documentation-only' and reduces install-time risk. The guide points users to standard public sources (npx, GitHub) rather than shipping code.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The SKILL.md tells users most GLM skills use ZHIPU_API_KEY and shows how to export it, but the registry metadata lists no required environment variables. The skill therefore documents access to a credential without declaring it. Also the SKILL.md presumes availability of tools (npx, git) that are not declared under required binaries.

dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: always is false, the skill is user-invocable and can be called by agents (normal). The skill does not request persistent presence, does not include installers that modify other skills, and explicitly states it contains no executable helper scripts.

dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill is mostly a harmless documentation hub, but note two inconsistencies: the guide instructs use of 'npx clawhub' and 'git' and tells you to set a ZHIPU_API_KEY, yet the skill metadata declares no required binaries or env vars. Before installing anything: (1) ensure you have npx/npm and git on your system; (2) verify the clawhub package source and the GitHub repositories it links to; (3) treat ZHIPU_API_KEY like any secret — only set it if you trust bigmodel.cn and the downstream skill you install, and prefer storing it in a secure credential manager rather than plaintext shell files; (4) inspect each target skill's SKILL.md and repo before running install commands. If the publisher updates metadata to declare ZHIPU_API_KEY and the required binaries, the inconsistency would be resolved and the skill would be coherent.
llm.findings: [no_findings] expected: The regex scanner found no code to analyze; this is expected because the skill is instruction-only (SKILL.md only).
